source_review: All100 complete clean reasoning traces; first accepted fresh trace for12 flagged questions; original question set unchanged.
corruption_review: All400 windows with original questions, clean window and prefix when required. Record actual false math, local edit constraints, meta instructions and final numeric answer leakage.
invalid_handling: Preserve all raw responses. Regenerate individually with exactly the same prompt/model/settings when no mathematical error, answer leakage, meta instruction or clear local-edit violation is found. Accept first passing response by attempt order. At most two replacement requests per context without a further documented decision. No model outcome based selection.
initial_reason: Original window already has a numeral or a mathematical division relation; GPT appended a new calculation instead of changing existing content. Original responses remain in corpus/v1 response archive.
context_reuse: Reuse only identical context IDs and exact request payloads, excluding documented invalid outputs.
